Attribution Plot Type (Shapley Values, Stepwise Ablation, and Dual Contrasts)

Source: R/type_attribution.R
type_attribution.Rd

Creates publication-grade attribution plots inspired by leakage-controlled machine learning and multi-omics drug target prioritization benchmarks. Supports three core styles:

  • "shapley": Horizontal or vertical bars displaying exact Shapley value attributions or feature-level contributions across mechanisms or feature tiers, with optional grouping across learners.

  • "stepwise": Stepwise mechanism removal / ablation curves tracing metric deterioration (e.g. AUROC or Average Precision) with 95% confidence intervals and step callouts.

  • "contrast": Dual-context attribution contrast comparing marginal impact when removed from a fully specified model vs. when added to an unaugmented baseline.

Usage

type_attribution(
  style = c("shapley", "stepwise", "contrast"),
  reference_line = NULL,
  annotate = TRUE,
  label_format = "%.3f",
  error_low = NULL,
  error_high = NULL,
  color_pos = "#B64342",
  color_neg = "#0F4D92",
  bar_width = 0.65,
  point_size = 3.5,
  text_size = 3,
  learner_colors = c(hgb = "#0F4D92", HGB = "#0F4D92", lr = "#B64342", LR = "#B64342", rf
    = "#42949E", RF = "#42949E"),
  ...
)

type_shapley(...)

type_stepwise(...)

Arguments

style

One of "shapley" (default), "stepwise", or "contrast".

reference_line

Numeric. Reference value for baseline (default 0 for Shapley/contrast; 0.5 for stepwise AUROC).

annotate

Logical. Whether to print numeric values on bars or points (default TRUE).

label_format

Character format string for annotations (default "\%.3f").

error_low

Column name or vector for lower error bounds in stepwise/contrast plots.

error_high

Column name or vector for upper error bounds in stepwise/contrast plots.

color_pos

Color for positive contributions (default "#B64342").

color_neg

Color for negative contributions (default "#0F4D92").

bar_width

Numeric bar width (default 0.65).

point_size

Numeric point size for stepwise/contrast (default 3.5).

text_size

Numeric text size for value annotations (default 3.0).

learner_colors

Named vector of colors for multi-learner contrasts (default: HGB = "#0F4D92", LR = "#B64342", RF = "#42949E").

...

Additional arguments.

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Shapley values across leakage mechanisms
df_shap = data.frame(
  mechanism = c("Label", "Prior Trials", "Attention", "Zero-fill", "Ungrouped CV"),
  shapley   = c(0.032, 0.020, 0.028, -0.008, 0.003),
  learner   = rep("HGB", 5)
)
cliplot(shapley ~ mechanism, data = df_shap, type = type_attribution(style = "shapley"))
} # }
